## Description

Wald tests and Wald confidence intervals
in R [@RCoreTeam-2026].
Each exported function has an internal version without input checks
that other projects can copy.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `wald` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/wald) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/wald")
```

## More Information

See
[GitHub Pages](https://ijapesigan.github.io/wald)
for package documentation.
